import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000009;
    static final long INF = MOD * MOD;

    static long mod_pow(long base, long exp, long m) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % m;
            base = (base * base) % m;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static class ModInt {
        long val;

        ModInt() {
            val = 0;
        }

        ModInt(long v) {
            val = v % MOD;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
        }

        ModInt(long v, long mod) {
            val = v % mod;
            if (val < 0) val += mod;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(val);
        }
    }

    static ModInt add(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
        ModInt res = new ModInt();
        res.val = (a.val + b.val) % MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static ModInt sub(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
        ModInt res = new ModInt();
        res.val = (a.val - b.val + MOD) % MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static ModInt mul(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
        ModInt res = new ModInt();
        res.val = (a.val * b.val) % MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static ModInt div(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
        return mul(a, new ModInt(mod_pow(b.val, MOD - 2, MOD)));
    }

    static final int MAX_N = 1 << 18;
    static ModInt[] fact = new ModInt[MAX_N];
    static ModInt[] factinv = new ModInt[MAX_N];

    static void init_factorials() {
        fact[0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N - 1; ++i) {
            fact[i + 1] = mul(fact[i], new ModInt(i + 1));
        }
        factinv[MAX_N - 1] = div(new ModInt(1), fact[MAX_N - 1]);
        for (int i = MAX_N - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
            factinv[i] = mul(factinv[i + 1], new ModInt(i + 1));
        }
    }

    static ModInt comb(int n, int k) {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return new ModInt(0);
        return mul(mul(fact[n], factinv[k]), factinv[n - k]);
    }

    static class mP {
        ModInt first;
        ModInt second;

        mP(ModInt f, ModInt s) {
            first = f;
            second = s;
        }

        mP(long f, long s) {
            first = new ModInt(f);
            second = new ModInt(s);
        }
    }

    static mP mul(mP a, mP b) {
        ModInt f = mul(a.first, b.first);
        ModInt s = add(mul(a.second, b.first), mul(a.first, b.second));
        return new mP(f, s);
    }

    static mP add(mP a, mP b) {
        return new mP(add(a.first, b.first), add(a.second, b.second));
    }

    static mP[] dp = new mP[501];

    static void precompute() {
        init_factorials();
        dp[0] = new mP(1, 0);
        dp[1] = new mP(2, 0);
        for (int n = 2; n <= 500; ++n) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                ModInt cnt = new ModInt(n + 1);
                ModInt sum = new ModInt(0);
                for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                    long diff = Math.abs(j - k);
                    sum = add(sum, new ModInt(diff));
                }
                mP cl = dp[j];
                mP cr = dp[n - 1 - j];
                mP x = mul(cl, cr);
                x.first = mul(x.first, comb(n - 1, j));
                x.second = mul(x.second, comb(n - 1, j));
                x = mul(x, new mP(cnt, sum));
                dp[n] = add(dp[n], x);
            }
        }
    }

    static mP[][] dp2 = new mP[502][501];

    static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        long newMod = sc.nextLong();
        if (newMod != 0) {
            // Update MOD if provided (though original code doesn't use this properly)
            // This is to match the behavior of reading MOD from input
        }
        precompute();
        dp2[0][0] = new mP(1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= i; ++k) {
                if (dp2[i][k] == null) continue;
                for (int j = i; j < n; ++j) {
                    int ni = Math.min(j + 2, n);
                    int nk = k + j - i + 1;
                    if (nk <= m) {
                        mP x = mul(dp2[i][k], dp[j - i + 1]);
                        x.first = mul(x.first, comb(ni, k));
                        x.second = mul(x.second, comb(ni, k));
                        if (dp2[ni][nk] == null) {
                            dp2[ni][nk] = new mP(0, 0);
                        }
                        dp2[ni][nk] = add(dp2[ni][nk], x);
                    }
                }
                if (dp2[i + 1][k] == null) {
                    dp2[i + 1][k] = new mP(0, 0);
                }
                dp2[i + 1][k] = add(dp2[i + 1][k], dp2[i][k]);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dp2[n][m].second.val);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        solve();
    }
}
